로마서 3:1.content: What advantage then hath the Jew? or what profit is there of circumcision?

로마서 3:2.content: Much every way: chiefly, because that unto them were committed the oracles of God.

로마서 3:3.content: For what if some did not believe? shall their unbelief make the faith of God without effect?

로마서 3:4.content: God forbid: yea, let God be true, but every man a liar; as it is written, That thou mightest be justified in thy sayings, and mightest overcome when thou art judged.

로마서 3:5.content: But if our unrighteousness commend the righteousness of God, what shall we say? Is God unrighteous who taketh vengeance? (I speak as a man)

로마서 3:6.content: God forbid: for then how shall God judge the world?

로마서 3:7.content: For if the truth of God hath more abounded through my lie unto his glory; why yet am I also judged as a sinner?

로마서 3:8.content: And not rather, (as we be slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say,) Let us do evil, that good may come? whose damnation is just.

로마서 3:9.content: What then? are we better than they? No, in no wise: for we have before proved both Jews and Gentiles, that they are all under sin;

로마서 3:10.content: As it is written, There is none righteous, no, not one:

로마서 3:11.content: There is none that understandeth, there is none that seeketh after God.

로마서 3:12.content: They are all gone out of the way, they are together become unprofitable; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.

로마서 3:13.content: Their throat is an open sepulchre; with their tongues they have used deceit; the poison of asps is under their lips:

로마서 3:14.content: Whose mouth is full of cursing and bitterness:

로마서 3:15.content: Their feet are swift to shed blood:

로마서 3:16.content: Destruction and misery are in their ways:

로마서 3:17.content: And the way of peace have they not known:

로마서 3:18.content: There is no fear of God before their eyes.

로마서 3:19.content: Now we know that what things soever the law saith, it saith to them who are under the law: that every mouth may be stopped, and all the world may become guilty before God.

로마서 3:20.content: Therefore by the deeds of the law there shall no flesh be justified in his sight: for by the law is the knowledge of sin.

로마서 3:21.content: But now the righteousness of God without the law is manifested, being witnessed by the law and the prophets;

로마서 3:22.content: Even the righteousness of God which is by faith of Jesus Christ unto all and upon all them that believe: for there is no difference:

로마서 3:23.content: For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of God;

로마서 3:24.content: Being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus:

로마서 3:25.content: Whom God hath set forth to be a propitiation through faith in his blood, to declare his righteousness for the remission of sins that are past, through the forbearance of God;

로마서 3:26.content: To declare, I say, at this time his righteousness: that he might be just, and the justifier of him which believeth in Jesus.

로마서 3:27.content: Where is boasting then? It is excluded. By what law? of works? Nay: but by the law of faith.

로마서 3:28.content: Therefore we conclude that a man is justified by faith without the deeds of the law.

로마서 3:29.content: Is he the God of the Jews only? is he not also of the Gentiles? Yes, of the Gentiles also:

로마서 3:30.content: Seeing it is one God, which shall justify the circumcision by faith, and uncircumcision through faith.

로마서 3:31.content: Do we then make void the law through faith? God forbid: yea, we establish the law.
